def head : List (List Nat) := [B00.input,B01.input,B02.input,B03.input,B04.input,B05.input,B06.input,B07.input]
def tail : List Nat := [244,46]
def message : List Nat := head.flatten ++ tail
def chunks : List (List Nat) := head ++ [B08.input]
theorem tailLength : tail.length=2 := by rfl
#print axioms tailLength
theorem headLength : head.flatten.length=512 := by
  simp only [head,List.length_flatten,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,List.sum_cons,List.sum_nil,lenB00,lenB01,lenB02,lenB03,lenB04,lenB05,lenB06,lenB07]
  omega
#print axioms headLength
theorem messageLength : message.length=514 := by
  simp only [message,List.length_append,headLength,tailLength]
#print axioms messageLength
theorem tailPad : tail ++ [128] ++ List.replicate 53 0 ++ [0,0,0,0,0,0,16,16] = [B08.input].flatten := by rfl
#print axioms tailPad
theorem padded : pad message=chunks.flatten := by
  rw [pad,messageLength]
  change (head.flatten ++ tail) ++ [128] ++ List.replicate 53 0 ++ [0,0,0,0,0,0,16,16]=_
  simp only [List.append_assoc,chunks,List.flatten_append]
  exact congrArg (fun t => head.flatten ++ t) (by simpa only [List.append_assoc] using tailPad)
#print axioms padded
theorem lengths : ∀ c ∈ chunks,c.length=64 := by
  intro c hc
  simp only [chunks,head,List.mem_append,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false,or_assoc] at hc
  rcases hc with h0|h1|h2|h3|h4|h5|h6|h7|h8
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
#print axioms lengths
theorem paddedLength : (pad message).length=576 := by
  rw [padded]
  simp only [chunks,head,List.flatten_append,List.flatten_cons,List.flatten_nil,List.length_append,List.length_nil,List.length_flatten,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,List.sum_cons,List.sum_nil,lenB00,lenB01,lenB02,lenB03,lenB04,lenB05,lenB06,lenB07,lenB08]
#print axioms paddedLength
theorem blockList : blocks ((pad message).length/64) (pad message)=chunks := by
  rw [paddedLength,padded]
  exact blocks_chunks chunks lengths
#print axioms blockList
def result : Reg := B08.result
theorem checked : JFp_SHA256.hash message=result := by
  unfold JFp_SHA256.hash
  dsimp only
  rw [blockList]
  simp only [chunks,head,List.foldl_append,List.foldl_cons,List.foldl_nil]
  rw [show initial=B00.start from rfl,B00.checked]
  rw [show B00.result=B01.start from rfl,B01.checked]
  rw [show B01.result=B02.start from rfl,B02.checked]
  rw [show B02.result=B03.start from rfl,B03.checked]
  rw [show B03.result=B04.start from rfl,B04.checked]
  rw [show B04.result=B05.start from rfl,B05.checked]
  rw [show B05.result=B06.start from rfl,B06.checked]
  rw [show B06.result=B07.start from rfl,B07.checked]
  rw [show B07.result=B08.start from rfl,B08.checked]
  rfl
#print axioms checked
end AspisR1.JHc_Gr_M0.Hash000

def head : List (List Nat) := [B00.input,B01.input,B02.input,B03.input,B04.input,B05.input,B06.input,B07.input]
def tail : List Nat := [219,111]
def message : List Nat := head.flatten ++ tail
def chunks : List (List Nat) := head ++ [B08.input]
theorem tailLength : tail.length=2 := by rfl
#print axioms tailLength
theorem headLength : head.flatten.length=512 := by
  simp only [head,List.length_flatten,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,List.sum_cons,List.sum_nil,lenB00,lenB01,lenB02,lenB03,lenB04,lenB05,lenB06,lenB07]
  omega
#print axioms headLength
theorem messageLength : message.length=514 := by
  simp only [message,List.length_append,headLength,tailLength]
#print axioms messageLength
theorem tailPad : tail ++ [128] ++ List.replicate 53 0 ++ [0,0,0,0,0,0,16,16] = [B08.input].flatten := by rfl
#print axioms tailPad
theorem padded : pad message=chunks.flatten := by
  rw [pad,messageLength]
  change (head.flatten ++ tail) ++ [128] ++ List.replicate 53 0 ++ [0,0,0,0,0,0,16,16]=_
  simp only [List.append_assoc,chunks,List.flatten_append]
  exact congrArg (fun t => head.flatten ++ t) (by simpa only [List.append_assoc] using tailPad)
#print axioms padded
theorem lengths : ∀ c ∈ chunks,c.length=64 := by
  intro c hc
  simp only [chunks,head,List.mem_append,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false,or_assoc] at hc
  rcases hc with h0|h1|h2|h3|h4|h5|h6|h7|h8
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
  · subst c; rfl
#print axioms lengths
theorem paddedLength : (pad message).length=576 := by
  rw [padded]
  simp only [chunks,head,List.flatten_append,List.flatten_cons,List.flatten_nil,List.length_append,List.length_nil,List.length_flatten,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,List.sum_cons,List.sum_nil,lenB00,lenB01,lenB02,lenB03,lenB04,lenB05,lenB06,lenB07,lenB08]
#print axioms paddedLength
theorem blockList : blocks ((pad message).length/64) (pad message)=chunks := by
  rw [paddedLength,padded]
  exact blocks_chunks chunks lengths
#print axioms blockList
def result : Reg := B08.result
theorem checked : JFp_SHA256.hash message=result := by
  unfold JFp_SHA256.hash
  dsimp only
  rw [blockList]
  simp only [chunks,head,List.foldl_append,List.foldl_cons,List.foldl_nil]
  rw [show initial=B00.start from rfl,B00.checked]
  rw [show B00.result=B01.start from rfl,B01.checked]
  rw [show B01.result=B02.start from rfl,B02.checked]
  rw [show B02.result=B03.start from rfl,B03.checked]
  rw [show B03.result=B04.start from rfl,B04.checked]
  rw [show B04.result=B05.start from rfl,B05.checked]
  rw [show B05.result=B06.start from rfl,B06.checked]
  rw [show B06.result=B07.start from rfl,B07.checked]
  rw [show B07.result=B08.start from rfl,B08.checked]
  rfl
#print axioms checked
end AspisR1.JHc_Gr_M0.Hash001
